name: National Cherry Blossom Festival 2027
job: Help Washington visitors distinguish festival dates from weather-dependent peak bloom and compare their own date scenarios.
facets: Festival date range versus uncertain bloom
User-entered travel and bloom window intersection

source_notes: Festival organiser lists 20 March–11 April 2027. NPS defines peak as 70% of Yoshino blossoms open and says development depends on weather. No 2027 peak forecast or parade date is claimed.
